description_html: Lead DevOps Cloud Engineer    Description -   As DevOps-Cloud Engineer in our team, you have responsibility to develop and support Hp Enterprise Integration solutions. You will have opportunity to grow your career through a variety of path inside one of the world’s leading technology companies.    The role entails leading and supporting the company's Generative AI platform initiatives. Responsibilities include supporting platform services and maintaining documentation to facilitate the utilization of Generative AI across various applications. This position plays a crucial role in advancing the company's AI capabilities and promoting innovation in AI-driven solutions.     Responsibilities:   Oversee day-to-day operations and support activities for the platform engineering team, ensuring efficient workflow and high-quality deliverables. Manage the team responsible for maintaining platform infrastructure, troubleshooting issues, and providing technical support. Develop and implement operational strategies to optimize processes, improve productivity, and enhance customer satisfaction. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and address operational challenges, ensuring alignment with business objectives. Monitor key performance metrics and implement corrective actions as needed to meet service level agreements (SLAs) and performance targets. Lead hiring, training, and performance evaluation processes for the operations and support team. Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in operations management and technical support.    What you will do in this role:   Work in tandem with other engineering teams to identify and implement optimal cloud-based solutions for the company  Define and document best practices and strategies regarding application deployment and infrastructure management  Provide guidance, thought leadership, and mentorship to development teams to build cloud competencies  Ensure application performance, uptime, scaling requirements are met, while maintaining high standards of design and implementation  Manage cloud environments in accordance to company security guidelines  Apply and adopt DevSecOps best practices     What you need to be successful in this role:   Minimum bachelor’s degree  10+ years of relevant experience  Technology skills:   o Expertise in common AWS services  IAM, VPC, EC2, EKS, S3, RDS, Route53, CloudWatch, Lambda, etc.  o Proficiency in containers  Docker, Kubernetes  o Competent with Linux  o Skilled in Infrastructure as Code – Terraform  o Source control management – GitHub  o Continuous Integration – Azure Pipelines, GitHub Actions  o Configuration management – Ansible  o Observability – Prometheus, Grafana, Fluentd, Elastic stack, etc.   Other traits: o Some prior experience with programming (any language) o Ability to work on multiple clouds (particularly, AWS and Azure) o Conversant with network, storage, and access management o Knowledgeable about cloud security and cloud cost optimization o Experienced in designing distributed systems for high availability o Familiar with microservices and messaging-based architecture o Good communication  Proven experience in operations management, technical support, or a similar role, preferably in a large enterprise environment.  Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop a team.  Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities, with a customer-centric approach.  Proficiency in project management methodologies and tools.  Familiarity with platform engineering concepts, cloud technologies, and Agile methodologies.      About the team:   Our mission is delivering world class Enterprise Integration standards to support Hp Global Digital Transformation. title: Senior Software Engineer, SRE and Production Engineering - DGX Cloud
description_html: NVIDIA DGX Cloud builds and operates large-scale GPU infrastructure for AI workloads. We are looking for Software Engineers with SRE or Production Engineering experience who have worked hands-on with bare-metal NVIDIA systems. This team builds the software and operational tooling that moves GPU capacity from installed hardware to production service supporting an IaaS production environment of BMaaS, VMaaS.    What you’ll be doing:    Build automation for bare-metal provisioning, hardware validation, firmware and software upgrades, repair, and cluster lifecycle management.  Develop tools that interact with BMC and Redfish interfaces to monitor hardware health, manage server state, and assist recovery workflows.  Handle and advance NVIDIA NVL72 systems and BlueField-3 or later DPUs throughout cloud partner and on-premises environments.  Diagnose failures across servers, DPUs, GPU systems, CPU systems, networking, Linux, and Kubernetes; turn recurring issues into automated detection and repair.  Define validation and handoff criteria so new capacity enters production safely and consistently.  Take part in on-call duties, incident response, root-cause analysis, and follow-up to implement permanent solutions.  Work with hardware, networking, platform, data center operations, and partner teams to resolve issues across ownership boundaries.     What we need to see:    8 + years building software for or operating production infrastructure, including substantial hands-on bare-metal experience.  Strong Go or Python skills, with a record of delivering production automation and services.  Direct experience with BMC and Redfish in server provisioning, health inspection, power management, or fault diagnosis.  Practical experience working directly with NVIDIA GPU hardware, such as NVL72 systems, and BlueField-3 or newer DPUs.  Experience with Linux, firmware and driver management, network boot, and the server lifecycle from initial provisioning through repair.  Experience managing production reliability through on-call duties, incident response, observability, and durable solutions.  Ability to debug failures across hardware, host operating systems, networking, and distributed services.  Clear communication and demonstrated ownership of problems that span multiple teams.  BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent experience in a practical setting.     Ways to stand out from the crowd:    Experience operating BlueField DPUs in DPU mode, including host-to-DPU connectivity and lifecycle debugging, with DPU or equivalent experience considered.  Background with NVLink, InfiniBand, Spectrum-X, or GPU cluster performance validation.  Experience building safe, repeatable workflows for rack-scale bringup, firmware upgrades, hardware replacement, and customer handoff.  Experience with Kubernetes, GitOps, Argo CD, SLOs, and fleet-wide automation.    At NVIDIA, you’ll help make next-generation AI infrastructure production-ready at scale!     Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 16, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer - Cloud
description_html: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.  Are you ready to be part of something outstanding? NVIDIA's Digital Marketing Organization seeks a senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our Santa Clara, CA team. As an SRE at NVIDIA, you will have a meaningful role in keeping our Digital Marketing Services reliable, fast, and efficient. You'll use innovative technology and work alongside skilled professionals who continuously explore new possibilities.     What you'll be doing:     Build and deploy large-scale dynamic URL redirects using Akamai Edge Redirector Cloudlets for promotional efforts and site migrations.    Configure Akamai Forward Rewrite Cloudlets to map inbound requests to SEO-friendly paths.    Provide on-call support for production-grade applications, responding to incidents, prioritizing issues, and driving resolution across deployment pipelines, Akamai CDN, WAF, and cloud infrastructure.    Author, test, and activate shared and non-shared Cloudlet Policies via the Akamai Cloudlets Policy Manager.    Maintain custom match criteria — including Geo, Device Characteristics, RegEx, and Query Strings — to ensure efficient origin offload and intelligent content delivery.    Quickly identify and address user-reported problems throughout the Digital Marketing Organization ecosystem.    On-board new applications, AI/ML services, and model endpoints on AWS Infrastructure.    Implement monitors, alerts, and SOPs to ensure early detection and accurate response to service-impacting issues, including tracking model drift and inference latency.       What we need to see:     MS or BS in Computer Science/Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.    8+ years’ experience supporting technical operations in a live-site production environment with a real passion for CDN automation, tooling, and infrastructure supporting AI applications.    Strong knowledge of the Kubernetes Platform, deployments, and cloud-native automation.    Proven strengths in problem-solving and root-causing issues, while continuously seeking ways to drive optimization, efficiency, and the bottom line.    Advanced level experience with scripting and development in Python, fully automating operational steps with “one-click” rapid solutions.    Key participation in the incident management process for early recognition of all service-impacting issues, accurate triage, partner communication, impact containment, service restoration, and post-incident follow-up. SRE On call experience is a must.       Ways to stand out from the crowd:     Strong Akamai CDN Support skills and deep understanding of edge computing/edge AI.    Solid experience with the AWS Cloud Platform and Kubernetes as a platform. SRE on-call experience.    Hands-on experience deploying and scaling Generative AI/LLM applications, integrating vector databases, or managing GPU-accelerated infrastructure.    Excellent communication, presentation, and analytical skills; the ability to communicate sophisticated infrastructure and AI concepts clearly across different audiences and varying levels of the organization.      Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family  www.nvidiabenefits.com/       Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 168,000 USD - 264,500 USD.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 16, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. description_html: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. Our Agentic AI Applications and Specialized Agents team is leading this transformation, driving innovation in AI-native software. or supporting production LLM or agentic AI systems.       Strong Python programming and practical proficiency with TypeScript or JavaScript.     Practical knowledge of orchestration frameworks, agent frameworks, RAG platforms, workflow automation systems, or AI application builders.       Familiarity with model serving and inference optimization, including NIM and Dynamo.       Experience with Kubernetes, Helm, containers, and GPU-backed workloads in cloud, hybrid, or on-prem environments.       Ability to debug across the full stack: application code, APIs, model endpoints, orchestration layers, retrieval systems, infrastructure, and security controls.       Expertise in working directly with customers in architectural roles and the capability to impact both creators and corporate decision-makers.       Comfort with uncertainty and the ability to rapidly transition from idea to proof of concept.        Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:     Practical experience working directly with NVIDIA NIM, Nemotron, NeMo, Dynamo, AI-Q, OpenShell, NemoClaw, or NVIDIA AI Enterprise.       Experience with platforms like Lovable, n8n, Haystack, LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, or MCP-based systems.       Expertise in secure agent runtime build, sandboxing, tool permissioning, confidential computing, policy-as-code, or enterprise governance controls.       Familiarity with DGX Spark as a local AI development platform, or experience crafting developer playbooks bridging desktop prototyping to data-center deployment.       Background in sovereign AI, regulated enterprise environments, or private/on-prem deployment models.       NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. title: Senior Solution Architect-CPQ
description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Customer Success    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.          Agentforce Revenue Management is an execution-focused technical leader responsible for architecting and delivering end-to-end migrations from legacy CPQ platforms (Salesforce CPQ, Industry CPQ, Conga CPQ, Apttus CPQ, inhouse legacy CPQ systems) to Salesforce Agentforce Revenue Management. As a foundational member of the Strategic Migration CoE and Migration Hub, you will act as primary technical authority for the Agentforce Revenue Management track — owning the solution design, product modelling, lead to cash architecture and asset lifecycle management. You will combine deep ARM platform expertise with advanced migration methodologies to ensure that customers are migrated from legacy platform to ARM with full integrity, compliance and zero business disruption.       Responsibilities:      Serve as a  Senior Solution Architect  for CPQ/ARM migration projects, contributing hands-on technical expertise and architectural leadership at approximately  50% utilization .     Design the CPQ Catalog and transactional data migration strategy , including lead to cash process, asset/subscription migration without minimal business disruption.     Architect the legacy to CPQ migration platform  with an understanding of object, fields, process and configuration mapping on a high level.     Own the revenue process and CPQ migration blueprint      Define end-to-end data lineage  including data profiling, cleansing logic, transformation mapping, and reconciliation strategies for product catalog, pricing, quote, and subscription objects.     Lead functional and technical workshops.  Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.     Lead a project team of developers  focused on driving optimized solutions for our clients leveraging Salesforce clouds.     Manage customer expectations ; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party stakeholders     Establish trust with the customer’s leadership , promoting and/or implementing best practices with Salesforce     Highlight and manage risk areas  in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion       Required Experience:       15+ years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects and handling individual contributors.    Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills    Demonstrated experience migrating complex, high-volume CPQ and Lead-to-Cash data (product catalogs, pricing models, subscriptions) with zero business disruption    Experience migrating from legacy CPQ platforms (Salesforce CPQ, Industry CPQ, Conga, Apttus, or custom legacy CPQ) to Agentforce Revenue Management    Experience migrating from complex CPQ/Revenue legacy environments (e.g., Salesforce CPQ, Industry CPQ, Apttus, Conga) to Agentforce Revenue Management.    Hands-on experience with ETL tools — Informatica Cloud, Talend, MuleSoft, Azure Data Factory — for large-scale revenue data extraction and transformation.    Strong interpersonal skills - nurture effective working relationships with others    Proficiency in English. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience             Unleash Your Potential    When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
